name: Kaneyama (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kaneyama town emblem in white: a four-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kaneyama, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 1966.

features.role: Kaneyama town emblem — a four-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character
